Sharad Pawar meets Eknath Shinde, sparking political speculation

NCP (SP) chief Sharad Pawar met with Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde, generating political discussion. The meeting has fueled rumors among Congress insiders about Pawar's party potentially joining the ruling Mahayuti alliance. Another meeting between Pawar and Arif Naseem Khan was also reported, aimed at assessing Pawar's political stance.
